args.title: Re-enable Export button after failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` function sets `busy` to `true` but does not reset it if the `exportReport` call fails. This leaves the Export button disabled after a failed export. The fix is to wrap the `exportReport` call in a `try-catch` block and set `busy` to `false` in the `catch` block to re-enable the button.
